🌏 March 2026 · Thailand
Featured Story

Six Girls from Wardha Won International Scholarships

On 4th March 2026, six students from Oxford Public School, Waigaon — daughters of farmers, first-generation learners — competed at the World Peace Ethics Contest in Thailand.

They came home with ranks, scholarships, and something harder to measure: the knowledge that where you are born does not decide how far you can go.

"This success inspires me to work harder and make my school proud." — Pratyasha Sahoo

On the same evening, Dr. Chetana Sawai received an international award for Excellence in Rural Girl Child Education from the Dhammakaya Foundation, Thailand.

Student Achievements

From Wardha to the World Stage

Every name here is a student from a real village in Wardha district.

🏋️ Sri Lanka
Ankush Atulkar
National Powerlifting Champion
A Fitter trade student at Chetana ITI from a humble background — won the National Powerlifting & Deadlift Championship, Guwahati, then represented India internationally in Sri Lanka.
🥇 Malaysia
Mahi Rajarkar
International Lathi Championship
Two National Gold Medals at the Solapur National Lathi-Kathi Competition. Selected to represent India at the International Championship, Malaysia — from a village in Wardha.
🎓 IIT
Asmita Ganvir
IIT Guwahati
Farming family. Village school stopped at Class 7. Oxford Public School gave her science faculty and English-medium instruction. She cracked JEE without any coaching institute.
"My teachers gave me confidence when I needed it most."
🎓 COEP Pune
Priyanka Sahare
Oxford Public School Alumna
From a farming family in Wardha — the first in her family to pursue higher education. Currently studying at COEP (College of Engineering, Pune) — one of Maharashtra's most competitive engineering institutions.
🏥 Public Health
Suraj Pawar
Lead Researcher · Program Manager
From a labourer tribal family with no education background. MSW 2018 graduate. Now Lead Researcher & Program Manager at AMHI AMCHYA AROGYASATHI — 7+ years improving maternal & child health in tribal communities.
🏆 Merit Rank
Rahul Khadse
Program Director · 20+ Years
MSW 2003 · University Merit Rank Holder (Top 3). Now Program Director at Vikas Sahyog Pratishthan — 20+ years leading large-scale state-level development projects under FCRA & CSR frameworks.
Collective Achievement

Asia Book of Records — Oxford Public School

Oxford Public School, Waigaon achieved recognition in the Asia Book of Records — a collective achievement reflecting the calibre of students and faculty CES has built over 30 years.

From a village school serving farming communities, to a record-holding institution recognised across Asia — this is what sustained investment in rural education looks like.

Beyond the Classroom

Impact That Reaches the Whole Community

Community Health Outreach
B.Ed and social work students partnering with ASHA workers to carry health awareness into surrounding villages — bridging the gap between institution and community.
Smart Agriculture Innovation
Students participated in a division-level competition with a smart agriculture watering system — bringing technology innovation to a farming-community school.
Legal Awareness & Access
Social work students visiting Family Court, Nagpur — building legal literacy and access to justice in communities that historically had none.
ITI Placement Drive
Dedicated placement drives connecting ITI graduates directly with employers — Railways, manufacturing, EV sector — turning trade certificates into stable careers.
Community Voices

In Their Own Words

Lalchand Mirsu Sawalkar
Forest Guard · Maharashtra Van Vibhag · Melghat · MSW 2016–18
"I came from a tribal community in Amravati — no means of livelihood, no one in the family with a stable income. Dr. Ambedkar College of Social Work, Wardha gave me a path. Today I serve as a Forest Guard in the Maharashtra Forest Department, posted at Sipna Wildlife Division, Melghat. Education changed everything."
Shrikant Nagrale
Fellow at Dasra · WASH Programme · MSW Alumnus
"No one in my family had gone to college before me. CES believed in me when I had no reason to believe in myself. Today I work on water and sanitation access for rural India — the same communities I came from."
Resham Lambade
B.Ed College alumna · Government Teacher
"I came from a small family with no government job in sight. Today, because of Chetana, I have one. And I give back to the next generation every day."
Amit Raut
Social Auditor · Mantralaya Mumbai · MSW Alumnus
"CES didn't just give me a degree — it gave me a purpose. Working at Mantralaya, I think of the students still in Wardha who deserve the same chance I got."
